description: Every run of NI-001 on the FE-001 mean environment case: solver settings, step statistics, located eclipse boundaries, segments, last-orbit solar array temperature and the error against the independent fourth order Runge-Kutta reference.

load.source: NI-001 input: one computing load start and one stop inside the last orbit, both in sunlight and away from the eclipse boundaries and from the output grid; in the thermal-only FE-001 case the load is the prescribed P_load_W of Compute01 and its start and stop are declared input discontinuities of the coupled run
